programmes.d: The chefs cook five commonly served "staple" dishes, but the challenge comes with a twist: each team will have to pick one member to leave the kitchen until only one is left.
Chef Ramsay introduces his daughter Tilly and tells the chefs they will create dishes for Tilly’s "Sweet 16" menu.
Chef Ramsay challenges the nine remaining chefs to prepare authentic Chinese dishes and each chef must crack open fortune cookies to reveal their ingredients for the challenge.
The dining room gets an Italian transformation for the blind taste test. Then, the teams cook to honor supporters of St. Jude Children's Research Hospital.
During the challenge, guest judge renowned pastry chef and chocolatier, Valerie Gordon cracks down hard on both teams' takes on dessert.
Chef Ramsay explains to the six remaining chefs that they will face three extensive challenges to determine which five chefs receive a black jacket.
The final five enter the kitchen to compete in the infamous "Taste It, Now Make It" challenge, attempting to replicate Chef Ramsay’s intricate eggs benedict dish.
The final four chefs participate in a tableside challenge, preparing them for the showmanship that the Las Vegas Executive Chef position will require.
After a shocking elimination, the final two chefs receive unexpected help for their final menus. Then, they share their highs and lows with Chef Ramsay over brunch.
The final contestants must learn menus and plan for the biggest service of their careers, taking place at Six Flags Magic Mountain. The winner of Season 18 is chosen.
Gordon Ramsay coaches another selection of hopeful chefs, with a job and $250,000 going to the winner.
The competition continues as the contestants try to land $250,000 and a job at Hell's Kitchen Lake Tahoe.
The chefs compete to cook for an Olympian and an NFL star.
The challenge in this episode sees the teams tackling a reception for newlyweds before a difficult service.
The teams are tasked with creating Mexican dishes.
The teams are challenged to put a twist on some classic Italian dishes.
The teams take on a compelling surf and turf dome challenge.
